input.quote: 24.1 Customer may assign this Agreement or an Order Form without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all assets or business to which the Agreement relates.
input.rationale: Section 24 meets our preferred position in full: 24.1 gives Customer a consent-free right to assign to an Affiliate or M&A successor (notice plus assumption only); 24.2 bars Vendor assignment, delegation of material performance, or transfer by change of control without our consent (not unreasonably withheld) and never to a direct competitor; 24.3 applies a reasonable-consent standard to other assignments; and 24.4 expressly denies Vendor any right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees, or reduce service on our change of control. Section 13.3 carries the same carve-out through to licence rights. No change-of-control trigger operates against us elsewhere (9.2 is an ordinary insolvency clause and expressly excludes lawful reorganizations). No redline needed.
